items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: When I left them I joined Bob Lyons band.

ctx.x: So it wasn't a rival band exactly then. They weren't trying to cash in on the name of the Tuxedo album. Oh no, no.

Celestan used to send us on jobs and things. Called the original Tuxedo and the Young Tuxedo. That's what the name was. I played with them. So it was wild. When I left them I joined Bob Lyons band. When I took Willie Edwards place.
You got his in the Bob Lyons band.
